question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a blue present, Bob has a gold present, and Claire has a teal present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. Finally, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Alice has the
Options:
(A) blue present
(B) gold present
(C) teal present
solution:
Gift colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (blue, gold, teal)
1. Bob ↔ Claire: (blue, teal, gold)
2. Bob ↔ Claire: (blue, gold, teal)
3. Bob ↔ Claire: (blue, teal, gold)
Alice has the blue present, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
